events.title: Vélez Sársfield wins the Intercontinental Cup in FC 도쿄, Japan by defeating Italy's AC 밀란 (2–0).

Teddy Sheringham scores a hat-trick as 토트넘 홋스퍼 beat 뉴캐슬 유나이티드 4–2 in the league at White Hart Lane . 블랙번 로버스 remain top of the table with a 3–0 away win over 윔블던, although an Eric Cantona goal gives 맨체스터 유나이티드 a 1–0 home win over 노리치 시티 to keep the gap between first and second place at one point. 맨체스터 시티's 2–1 at 입스위치 타운 takes them to within one point and one place of the top five. A match in Division One sees 셰필드 유나이티드 win 6–3 at Luton and move to the brink of the playoff places.
맨체스터 유나이티드 bow out of the Champions League despite beating 갈라타사라이 4–0 at Old Trafford in their final group game. Young midfielders 사이먼 데이비스 and 데이비드 베컴 score their first goals for the club.
The Football Association quashes 토트넘 홋스퍼's FA Cup ban and 6-point deduction.

노팅엄 포리스트 beat 입스위치 타운 4–1; all the goals are scored in the first-half. 블랙번 로버스 scrape a 3–2 home win over 사우샘프턴 to maintain their lead of the Premier League. 맨체스터 유나이티드 keep up the pressure with a 3–2 win over QPR at Loftus Road ; 폴 스콜스 scores twice for the visitors and Les Ferdinand – one of the strikers whose name has recently been linked with a move to Old Trafford – scores twice for the hosts.

아스널 manager George Graham denies allegations that he received an illegal £285,000 payment as part of a transfer deal. 에버턴 pay a club record fee of £4 million for 레인저스 striker Duncan Ferguson, who has been on loan at Goodison Park for two months.

Scarborough , who are bottom of Division Three, sack manager Billy Ayre , with former manager Ray McHale returning to the club for his second spell in charge. Though the vast majority of the clubs in the Football Conference still do not have grounds suitable for hosting League football, current Conference leaders 매클즈필드 타운 's Moss Rose ground was used by 체스터 시티 from 1990 to 1992, making it seem likely that they will be promoted if they win the Conference.
Clarence Seedorf scores the fifth and last goal during his debut for the Netherlands national team against Luxembourg. Pierre van Hooijdonk also earns his first cap for the Netherlands.
Mark McGhee leaves Reading to take charge of 레스터 시티. He is replaced at Elm Park by 35-year-old players Jimmy Quinn and Mick Gooding .

맨체스터 유나이티드 suffer their first home league defeat of the season when they go down 2–1 at home to 노팅엄 포리스트, who win the game with goals from Stuart Pearce and Stan Collymore , squandering the chance to go top of the league. Tony Cottee scores a hat-trick for 웨스트햄 유나이티드 in their 3–0 home league win over 맨체스터 시티.
John Lyall resigns after four-and-a-half years in charge of 입스위치 타운, who are currently bottom of the Premier League.
Former 리버풀 manager Graeme Souness denies allegations that he received a £30,000 illegal payment in connection with a player transfer.
Brian Little's rebuilding of 애스턴 빌라 begins when he signs midfielder Ian Taylor from 셰필드 웬즈데이, with striker Guy Whittingham moving in the opposite direction in a deal worth £1 million.
Boxing Day drama in the Premier League sees 블랙번 로버스 stay on top by beating 맨체스터 시티 3–1 at Maine Road , while 맨체스터 유나이티드 keep up the pressure with a thrilling 3–2 away win over 첼시.

1994 draws to a close with 블랙번 로버스 still top and now with a three-point lead over 맨체스터 유나이티드 as well as a game in hand. 리버풀 and 노팅엄 포리스트 are still in distant contention while a resurgent 토트넘 홋스퍼 are now putting pressure on the top five, while 리즈 유나이티드 and 맨체스터 시티's challenges are practically dead and buried as they have slid down the table considerably. 노리치 시티, meanwhile, finish 1994 in seventh place as manager John Deehan looks set to defy the critics who felt he could never successfully replace Mike Walker and mount a challenge for another European place. The month-end bottom four of 에버턴, 애스턴 빌라, 입스위치 타운 and 레스터 시티 remain unchanged from last month. 미들즈브러 continue to lead the Division One promotion race, now five points ahead of their nearest rivals 울버햄프턴 원더러스. 트랜미어 로버스, Reading and 셰필드 유나이티드 complete the top five, while the change of manager at 스윈던 타운 has made little difference to their league form (though they continue to progress well in the League Cup) as they are only outside the relegation zone on goal difference. The final Premier League games of 1994 include a 3–1 win for QPR against 아스널 at Highbury, 맨체스터 유나이티드 being held to a 2–2 draw at 사우샘프턴, leaders 블랙번 로버스 winning 1–0 at 크리스털 팰리스 and 토트넘 홋스퍼 climbing into sixth place with a 4–0 win at Coventry. 울버햄프턴 원더러스 keep up their Division One promotion push with a 3–1 win at 반즐리 , whose own promotion hopes are dented as a result. Leaders 미들즈브러 draw 1–1 at Stoke. 번리 climb out of the relegation zone with a 5–1 home win over Southend.
